source_notes: IRDAI Regulations 2024 + Ditto ULIP charges guide + advisor policy-evaluation framework (XIRR, surrender ratio)

rules.check: XIRR of the benefit illustration vs term+SIP alternative (computed by calculator)
rules.explain_template: This policy's real return (XIRR) is below {threshold}% — a plain savings account or FD would beat it. The gap is the opportunity cost of staying invested.
rules.action_template: Compare against a term plan + SIP before deciding to keep paying premiums.

rules.explain_template: A premium allocation charge above {threshold}% means that share of every premium is deducted before it is invested — you pay it year after year.
rules.action_template: Ask for the year-by-year premium allocation schedule before renewing.

rules.check: fund management charge (ULIP, % of fund value)
rules.explain_template: A fund management charge above {threshold}% compounds against your fund value year after year and quietly erodes returns.
rules.action_template: Compare fund management charges across insurers.

rules.check: surrender value vs premiums paid (computed by calculator)
rules.explain_template: Surrendering now would lose a large share of the premiums you have paid.
rules.action_template: Get the current surrender value in writing before deciding to exit.

rules.check: policy admin / mortality / surrender charges disclosed in the schedule
rules.explain_template: Multiple stacked charges (admin, mortality, surrender) can consume more than {threshold}% of each premium.
rules.action_template: List every charge in the policy schedule and total what it costs per year.

rules.check: product type vs the buyer's likely need (ULIP/endowment sold as investment)
rules.explain_template: An investment-linked product (ULIP/endowment) sold as a pure 'investment' is a classic mis-selling pattern — the insurance cost quietly eats the returns.
rules.action_template: Check what you were told at sale vs what the policy actually is.

rules.explain_template: You have a {threshold}-day free-look window from receiving the policy document to cancel and get a full refund.
rules.action_template: If the policy is recent, decide within the free-look window.

rules.check: premium payment term vs policy term
rules.explain_template: The premium payment term (how long you pay) is shorter than the policy term (how long you are covered) — confirm this is what you expected.
rules.action_template: Note the difference between premium term and coverage term.
